summary: All 15 phases complete and independently re-verified this dispatch: the unscoped check-task-references.sh reports 0 unexempted occurrences across agent-system/extensions, .opencode, lua, and .memory; all 31 hook regression fixtures pass; validate-no-task-references.sh is registered exactly once as a blocking PreToolUse hook (verified via direct fixture exercise, not just registration). Two deploy-tree defects were discovered and fixed during verification (a duplicated .claude/CLAUDE.md and a stale email-preference-harvest.sh copy); a pre-existing, task-941-unrelated literature-extension deploy gap remains and is out of scope.
decisions_made: Verified (not merely trusted) the prior dispatch's completion claim: re-ran the unscoped check-task-references.sh from the source store (0/0/0/0 across all four trees) and the 31-fixture regression suite (31 passed, 0 failed) independently this dispatch.

Discovered the deployed .claude/settings.json still carries the OLD advisory PostToolUse registration for validate-no-task-references.sh (with the exit-2-neutralizing `2>/dev/null || echo '{}'` wrapper) alongside the new blocking PreToolUse registration. This is the already-documented 'add-only merge cannot remove' deploy-mechanism gap (see the rule's Enforcement section and verify-deploy.sh's own non-blocking WARN for exactly this class of issue) -- the new PreToolUse gate is independently verified live and blocking, so the stale advisory duplicate does not compromise the enforcement objective. Left in place per the documented gap rather than hand-edited, matching the source-store-deploy-boundary posture.

Discovered and FIXED a real defect: .claude/CLAUDE.md had duplicated content (897 lines of correct content plus ~900 lines of pre-fix stale content concatenated under one header), left over from an earlier merge-reinject pass that appended rather than replaced. Fixed by calling merge.lua's generate_claudemd() directly (a fully deterministic, non-append regenerator) via headless Neovim -- confirmed single 897-line copy with 0 unexempted task-reference occurrences afterward.

Discovered and FIXED a real defect: .claude/scripts/email-preference-harvest.sh (an already-loaded extension's plain-copied script) was stale by exactly this task's own Category-1 fix (dropping a parenthetical task citation). Confirmed via check-extension-docs.sh's per-extension drift check (email: FAIL -> PASS after fix), fixed via a direct one-off file copy from the source store, matching the precedent already recorded in the plan's Phase 15 deviation note for this same class of gap.

Confirmed remaining `bash .claude/scripts/verify-deploy.sh` FAIL is caused solely by a pre-existing, task-941-unrelated literature-extension deploy gap (several literature scripts were never deployed to this repo at all, predating this task and touching no file in this task's modified_files list) -- not a regression from this task's work.

Confirmed meta-builder-agent.md correctly has NO MUST-NOT task-reference bullet and needs none: the agent's own contract states it 'NEVER implements changes directly - it only creates tasks' (specs/**-only output), so the rule's existing accounting (4 agents carry the bullet; 3 named agents are a known, accepted gap) is complete and accurate as-is.
